theme_and_archetype.rationale: High-end French marketplace for digital assets requires a trustworthy, premium interface. Relying strictly on the user-provided Navy & Gold palette to convey authority and value.

typography.strategy: Avoid generic fonts like Inter for headings. Use Cabinet Grotesk for a premium, authoritative heading structure. IBM Plex Sans for highly legible, data-heavy body text.

layout_strategy.mobile: 1-column layout, vertically stacked sections. Container padding p-4.
layout_strategy.desktop: Compact header + 4-column KPI row + 3-column main split (2 cols content, 1 col sidebar).

header.description: Compact top navigation bar, completely decoupled from the main content grid.
header.components: User avatar (Initials or Photo), 'Bonjour, Marie !', and a subtle 'Déconnexion' ghost button.
header.spacing: flex justify-between items-center py-4 px-6 border-b border-[#DDE3EA] bg-white mb-8

kpi_and_cta_row.description: Top row highlighting the most crucial stats and the primary CTA. Solves the 'no stats at a glance' problem.
kpi_and_cta_row.layout: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 mb-8

cards.title: Publier une annonce
cards.subtitle: Mettez votre actif en vente
cards.style: bg-[#0F2747] text-white hover:bg-[#0F2747]/90 transition-colors border-none shadow-md cursor-pointer

blocks.title: À Traiter
blocks.description: Pending actions transformed from a heavy block to a sleek, actionable list.
blocks.style: bg-white rounded-xl border border-[#DDE3EA] p-6 shadow-sm mb-8
blocks.empty_state: Sleek horizontal row with success icon (#22C55E) and text 'Tout est à jour. Aucune action requise.'

blocks.title: Administration
blocks.style: bg-white rounded-xl border border-[#DDE3EA] p-6 shadow-sm

ui_components.cards: Use Shadcn Cards but with custom borders (#DDE3EA) and zero/subtle shadow. Use rounded-xl for a modern premium feel.
ui_components.buttons: Shadcn buttons. Primary buttons use #0F2747 background. Secondary buttons use transparent background with #DDE3EA border.

micro_interactions.hover_states: Interactive Cards should have a subtle -translate-y-1 and shadow-md transition on hover. Links/Text should change text color to #C9A45C.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. DO NOT use generic fonts like Inter or Roboto for headings; configure Cabinet Grotesk or similar geometric/premium sans.
2. Create the layout strictly using the color hex codes provided, mapping them precisely to Tailwind classes in tailwind.config.js.
3. Extract the 'Publier une annonce' out of the generic list and make it a highly visible CTA card in the KPI row.
4. Dismantle the 8-card identical grid. Re-route 'Mes annonces', 'Mes transactions', and 'Mes messages' into the top KPI summary cards (where clicking the card acts as the navigation).
5. Group 'Mon profil' and 'Mes factures' into an 'Administration' sidebar/column on the right.
6. Make the 'À traiter' block a clean list view (Shadcn Table or custom Flex rows) rather than a giant empty card.
7. Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
